Women's Boxing Fitness · Beginner Friendly

Boxing, Built for
Women.

Women's Boxing at Maddog is a dedicated, no-contact boxing fitness class built specifically for women — whether you're a busy mom carving out time for yourself, completely new to fitness, or just want to train somewhere that doesn't feel intimidating. Real pad work, real technique, taught by Coach Marcele in a class made up entirely of women at every fitness level.

You do not need any boxing background, any particular fitness level, or any equipment of your own. Just show up — everything else is taken care of.
  • Pad work and combination drilling — real boxing technique
  • No sparring, no contact — a safe, fitness-focused environment
  • Small, supportive class made up entirely of women
  • Beginner-paced — nobody is left behind

Common Questions

Frequently Asked
Questions.

Do I need boxing experience to join?
No experience needed at all. Most members are complete beginners — the class is built to teach real technique from the ground up, at a pace that works for you.
Will I have to spar or fight?
No. Women's Boxing is a dedicated, no-contact class — real pad work and technique with Coach Marcele, but no sparring at any point. It's a safe, fitness-focused environment for every level.
What should I wear or bring?
Comfortable gym kit and a water bottle. Gloves and hand wraps are available on-site for your first class — nothing to buy before you try it.
Is childcare available during class?
Not currently — there is no childcare facility on-site during Women's Boxing classes at this time.
Is this class only for moms?
No — it's open to any woman who wants a supportive, beginner-friendly environment to train boxing in, moms and non-moms alike.
How much does Women's Boxing cost?
Women's Boxing runs on the standard Boxing Fitness membership — R890 per month (2x per week), or R150 per drop-in class with no commitment. Your first class is free.
